+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { getCatalog } from '~/server/queries'
+
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/catalog')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      GET: async ({ request }) => {
+        const url = new URL(request.url)
+        return Response.json(getCatalog({
+          model: (url.searchParams.get('model') || 'all') as never,
+          category: (url.searchParams.get('category') || 'all') as never,
+          sort: (url.searchParams.get('sort') || 'featured') as never,
+          query: url.searchParams.get('query') || '',
+          favoriteOnly: url.searchParams.get('favoriteOnly') === 'true',
+        }))
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})
*** End Patch

+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { checkout, getCart, setCartItem } from '~/server/queries'
+
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/cart')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      GET: async () => Response.json(getCart()),
+      POST: async ({ request }) => {
+        const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({})) as { promptId?: number; add?: boolean; checkout?: boolean }
+        if (body.checkout) return Response.json(checkout())
+        if (!body.promptId || typeof body.add !== 'boolean') return Response.json({ error: 'promptId and add are required' }, { status: 400 })
+        return Response.json(setCartItem(body.promptId, body.add))
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})
*** End Patch
